summary: Inspected the latest successful NOEMA Discovery artifact (119 candidates; priority queue 2 RECENT_PUBLICATION, 0 UPCOMING_OR_AHEAD_OF_PRINT, 28 NEWLY_INDEXED_LEGACY). Added four deduplicated candidate-only records: the Modrice Hallstatt isotope dataset, Tepecik-Ciftlik incised obsidian arrowheads, an experimental chimpanzee crystal-attraction study, and a clearly labeled non-peer-reviewed BIAD/aDNA mortuary preprint. Recorded a publication-status contradiction for a Wiley chapter whose Crossref 2026 date conflicts with a parent volume marketed as 2027. No evidence or relationships were promoted and no verified dating revision was found.
